title: No one programmed this robot to walk, it taught itself
title_candidates: What it looks like when a robot thinks with its entire body
Google put its most powerful AI inside a humanoid robot
A robot that doesn't need to be told how to move
No one programmed this robot to walk, it taught itself
How close we are to robots that move like people
caption:
Google just dropped its AI into a robot and let it figure out how to move its entire body on its own.

Gemini Robotics 2 works with Apptronik to give robots whole body control. Instead of programming each step and grab by hand, the AI reacts to what it sees and feels, coordinating every part of the body at once.
